recurring_findings.finding: Existing selected mechanisms can already deliver closed useful answers.
recurring_findings.observation: Support followed by its actual recapture, observed escape or checking use, same-position continuations and confirmed line endings are sometimes retained together. For example, 11 keeps the full alternative knight and queen exchange; 46 closes Bxd4/Rxd4; 79 retains Kxg6/Rxa7 in both lines; 110 retains the alternative rook price, promotion and witnessed mate.
recurring_findings.implication: Preserve and reuse the existing selected question, mechanism and account ownership. These successes do not require a new graph or ranking framework.

recurring_findings.finding: Independent histories and later counts frequently displace the root answer.
recurring_findings.observation: A future move-order list, a common later defence, or a capture count can occupy the basic answer without explaining the selected root move. Equal pawn counts can also hide which pawn was lost. Root SAN presence does not itself communicate the root mechanism.
recurring_findings.implication: Keep independently closed histories in details unless they answer the selected question or change that answer. This research does not resolve a general importance ordering between two independent complete questions.

recurring_findings.finding: A selected gain or protection can be misleading when related price or compensation on another square is dropped.
recurring_findings.observation: Examples in the same supplied pair include Rxd4 compensation before Rxc8 at 38; Bxa1/Rxa1 around Nxb8/Rxb8 at 45; and Kxg6/Rxa7 where the pawn loss is shown without the compensating pawn capture at 73, 75, 76 and 80. The complete treatment of that last account at 79 is a direct counterexample to treating the missing compensation as unavailable evidence. At 91 the alternative supported b-pawn later dies to Kxb5 before the displayed Rxd3 gain.
recurring_findings.implication: The narrow content boundary is ownership of the selected account: retain the witnessed reply, loss or compensation that changes its gain, support or trade meaning. Do not turn all later captures into mandatory basic content.

recurring_findings.finding: Promotion and escape context may be necessary even when the capture interval alone is closed.
recurring_findings.observation: The supplied alternative at 72 promotes with g8=N before the displayed Rxg8/Kxg8 exchange. At 117 the native line loses the g-pawn to Rxg7 and later promotes the a-pawn, while the alternative also promotes the a-pawn; the core instead centers clearance and a later rook capture. At 118 a pawn identity is rendered at g3 after promotion to a queen, and Kxf7 is shown without Kxe5. At 121 the alternative loses the original rook to Rxa5 and later creates a new rook by a8=R before the shown rook checks. Successful promotion and ending delivery at 87, 89, 110 and 120 shows that these contexts can already be represented.
recurring_findings.implication: Retain the role-changing context required by the selected trajectory or result before expression. Promotion is not an ordinary capture-loss count. No example here establishes that the native move or the observed response is forced or uniquely necessary.

synthesis.already_works: Existing questions and mechanisms sometimes carry root purpose, actual use, reply, price and line result through to a useful basic answer. All 121 moves have explicit individual review rows; no subset was selected because it failed.
synthesis.smallest_existing_boundary_to_improve: Between the selected question or mechanism account and its basic core, preserve the reply or outcome context that changes that exact selected claim. Move independent histories to details without reinterpreting them in the formatter. The existing successful account paths are the reference; this review proposes no new generic framework, SAN-specific rule or global ranker.
synthesis.unresolved: General importance between independently closed explanations remains unresolved. Manual dilution and some distant price or compensation flags depend on reader judgement. This is an open research corpus and LLM reading, not an independent human evaluation, heldout generalization result or release certification.
synthesis.information_and_execution_limits: Actual-game or book futures absent from or incompatible with the supplied pair are not required content. Supplied continuations demonstrate witnessed behavior, not a forced response or proof over all alternatives. The reviewer did not use engines or a browser, edit product code, or modify frozen independent notes; research packet limitations do not establish actual browser failures.
